# Purpose

This report evaluates whether biomedical model outputs reproduce the
individual linguistic-feature shifts observed between authentic general and
authentic biomedical language. It reports significant-feature recovery,
agreement with the authentic Borda feature ranking, effect-direction
agreement, and sampling stability.

The independent authentic upper bound is evaluated only in
`04_upper_bound_calibration.qmd`. It is excluded from the model summaries and
figures below.

```{r uv-setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 7
)

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

source(file.path("analysis", "helpers.R"))

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12))
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
```

```{r uv-configuration}
paths <- analysis_paths()
result_root <- paths$univariate_results
real_results_dir <- Sys.getenv(
  "ANALYSIS_REAL_RESULTS_DIR",
  unset = file.path(result_root, "real")
)

primary_contrast <- "real_general_vs_biomedical"
upper_bound_model_id <- "upper_bound"
alpha <- 0.05

minimum_iteration_coverage <- 0.95
minimum_direction_agreement <- 0.90
minimum_top_k_rate <- 0.80
cluster_recovery_threshold <- 0.50
```

# Inputs

```{r uv-load}
univariate_bundle <- load_analysis_results(
  result_root = result_root,
  files = c(
    "per_lang_scores",
    "balanced_stability_feature_summary",
    "balanced_stability_rank_summary"
  ),
  stable_files = c(
    "stable_significant_scores",
    "per_lang_clusters"
  ),
  real_results_dir = real_results_dir
)

per_lang_scores <- univariate_bundle$primary$per_lang_scores
balanced_feature_summary <-
  univariate_bundle$primary$balanced_stability_feature_summary
balanced_rank_summary <-
  univariate_bundle$primary$balanced_stability_rank_summary
stable_significant_scores <-
  univariate_bundle$stable$stable_significant_scores
stable_per_lang_clusters <-
  univariate_bundle$stable$per_lang_clusters

real_feature_fps <- read_real_table(real_results_dir, "feature_fps")
real_per_lang_scores <- read_real_table(
  real_results_dir,
  "per_lang_scores"
)
real_cluster_fps <- read_real_table(
  real_results_dir,
  "cluster_fps",
  required = FALSE
)

if (nrow(stable_significant_scores) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "No stability-supported significant scores were found. ",
    "Run src/alignment/univariate_stability.R first."
  )
}
```

# Feature-level alignment

Permutation significance defines the primary feature inventory. Balanced
resampling is reported separately as a robustness check and does not replace
the permutation test.

```{r uv-prepare-scores}
full_scores <- per_lang_scores |>
  mutate(
    language = as.character(language),
    is_significant = is.finite(q_perm) & q_perm <= alpha
  )

model_language_inventory <- full_scores |>
  filter(
    contrast == primary_contrast,
    model_id != upper_bound_model_id
  ) |>
  distinct(analysis_model, model_id, model_label, language)

significant_scores <- full_scores |>
  filter(
    contrast == primary_contrast,
    model_id != upper_bound_model_id,
    is_significant
  ) |>
  distinct(
    analysis_model,
    model_id,
    model_label,
    language,
    feature,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

stable_scores <- stable_significant_scores |>
  filter(
    contrast == primary_contrast,
    model_id != upper_bound_model_id
  ) |>
  mutate(language = as.character(language)) |>
  distinct(
    analysis_model,
    model_id,
    model_label,
    language,
    feature,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

authentic_feature_reference <- real_feature_fps |>
  mutate(language = as.character(language)) |>
  distinct(language, feature, direction)

authentic_scores <- real_per_lang_scores |>
  mutate(language = as.character(language)) |>
  distinct(language, feature, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

## Significant-feature recovery

```{r uv-feature-recovery}
authentic_feature_counts <- authentic_feature_reference |>
  count(language, name = "n_authentic_significant")

model_feature_counts <- significant_scores |>
  count(
    analysis_model,
    model_id,
    model_label,
    language,
    name = "n_model_significant"
  )

feature_overlap <- significant_scores |>
  inner_join(
    authentic_feature_reference |>
      rename(authentic_direction = direction),
    by = c("language", "feature")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    model_direction_sign = normalize_direction(direction),
    authentic_direction_sign = normalize_direction(authentic_direction),
    direction_agrees = case_when(
      is.na(model_direction_sign) |
        is.na(authentic_direction_sign) ~ NA,
      TRUE ~ model_direction_sign == authentic_direction_sign
    )
  )

feature_overlap_counts <- feature_overlap |>
  group_by(analysis_model, model_id, model_label, language) |>
  summarise(
    n_recovered = n_distinct(feature),
    direction_agreement = if_else(
      any(!is.na(direction_agrees)),
      mean(direction_agrees, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

feature_recovery <- model_language_inventory |>
  left_join(authentic_feature_counts, by = "language") |>
  left_join(
    model_feature_counts,
    by = c("analysis_model", "model_id", "model_label", "language")
  ) |>
  left_join(
    feature_overlap_counts,
    by = c("analysis_model", "model_id", "model_label", "language")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(n_authentic_significant, n_model_significant, n_recovered),
      ~ replace_na(.x, 0L)
    ),
    recall = safe_ratio(n_recovered, n_authentic_significant),
    precision = safe_ratio(n_recovered, n_model_significant),
    f1 = safe_f1(precision, recall)
  )
```

## Agreement with the complete feature ranking

Borda agreement uses all common valid features. It is therefore not
conditioned on either model or authentic significance.

```{r uv-borda-agreement}
borda_agreement <- full_scores |>
  filter(
    contrast == primary_contrast,
    model_id != upper_bound_model_id
  ) |>
  select(
    analysis_model,
    model_id,
    model_label,
    language,
    feature,
    model_borda = borda_score
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    authentic_scores |>
      select(language, feature, authentic_borda = borda_score),
    by = c("language", "feature")
  ) |>
  group_by(analysis_model, model_id, model_label, language) |>
  summarise(
    n_common_features = n(),
    rho_borda = safe_spearman(model_borda, authentic_borda),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

model_language_summary <- feature_recovery |>
  left_join(
    borda_agreement,
    by = c("analysis_model", "model_id", "model_label", "language")
  ) |>
  add_model_readable()

model_language_summary
```

# Sampling stability

The stability criteria require sufficient iteration coverage, agreement with
the full-data effect direction, and regular appearance among the highest-ranked
features.

```{r uv-stability}
feature_stability <- balanced_feature_summary |>
  filter(
    contrast == primary_contrast,
    model_id != upper_bound_model_id
  ) |>
  mutate(
    full_significant = is.finite(full_q_perm) & full_q_perm <= alpha,
    stable_coverage =
      is.finite(iteration_coverage) &
        iteration_coverage >= minimum_iteration_coverage,
    stable_direction =
      is.finite(delta_sign_agreement) &
        delta_sign_agreement >= minimum_direction_agreement,
    stable_rank =
      is.finite(top_k_rate) & top_k_rate >= minimum_top_k_rate,
    stable = stable_coverage & stable_direction & stable_rank
  )

stability_by_language <- feature_stability |>
  group_by(analysis_model, model_id, model_label, language) |>
  summarise(
    n_full_significant = sum(full_significant),
    n_significant_and_stable = sum(full_significant & stable),
    prop_significant_stable = safe_ratio(
      n_significant_and_stable,
      n_full_significant
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    balanced_rank_summary |>
      filter(
        contrast == primary_contrast,
        model_id != upper_bound_model_id
      ) |>
      select(
        analysis_model,
        model_id,
        model_label,
        language,
        median_rank_stability = median_spearman_rho
      ),
    by = c("analysis_model", "model_id", "model_label", "language")
  )

model_summary <- model_language_summary |>
  left_join(
    stability_by_language,
    by = c("analysis_model", "model_id", "model_label", "language")
  ) |>
  group_by(analysis_model, model_id, model_label, model_readable) |>
  summarise(
    n_languages = n_distinct(language),
    macro_recall = mean(recall, na.rm = TRUE),
    macro_precision = mean(precision, na.rm = TRUE),
    macro_f1 = mean(f1, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_borda_rho = median(rho_borda, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_direction_agreement = mean(direction_agreement, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_significant_feature_stability = mean(
      prop_significant_stable,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    median_rank_stability = median(median_rank_stability, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(macro_f1), desc(median_borda_rho))

model_summary

write_csv(
  model_summary,
  analysis_output_path(paths$tables, "univariate_model_summary.csv")
)
```

# Model comparison

```{r uv-recovery-plot, fig.width=11, fig.height=10}
recovery_plot_data <- model_language_summary |>
  mutate(
    model_readable = fct_reorder(
      model_readable,
      recall,
      .fun = mean,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

recovery_plot <- ggplot(
  recovery_plot_data,
  aes(x = recall, y = model_readable, colour = language)
) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitter(height = 0.12, width = 0),
    alpha = 0.75,
    size = 1.8
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = model_summary,
    aes(x = macro_recall, y = model_readable),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 18,
    colour = "black",
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Recall of authentic significant features",
    y = NULL,
    colour = "Language"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

recovery_plot

ggsave(
  analysis_output_path(paths$figures, "univariate_feature_recovery.pdf"),
  recovery_plot,
  width = 11,
  height = 10
)
```

    title = "Agreement with the authentic Borda feature ranking"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

borda_plot

ggsave(
  analysis_output_path(paths$figures, "univariate_borda_agreement.pdf"),
  borda_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 12
)

# Recurrently recovered features

```{r uv-recurrent-features}
stable_feature_overlap <- stable_scores |>
  inner_join(
    authentic_feature_reference |>
      select(language, feature),
    by = c("language", "feature")
  )

model_totals_by_language <- stable_scores |>
  distinct(language, model_id) |>
  count(language, name = "n_models")

recurrent_recovered_features <- stable_feature_overlap |>
  distinct(model_id, language, feature) |>
  count(language, feature, name = "n_models_recovering_feature") |>
  left_join(model_totals_by_language, by = "language") |>
  mutate(
    prop_models = safe_ratio(n_models_recovering_feature, n_models)
  ) |>
  group_by(language) |>
  arrange(desc(n_models_recovering_feature), feature, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  ungroup()

recurrent_recovered_features
```

# Correlated-feature clusters

Clusters provide a secondary summary of correlated univariate features.
Recovery uses maximum-cardinality one-to-one matching, preventing one model
cluster from recovering several authentic clusters.

```{r uv-cluster-recovery}
if (nrow(real_cluster_fps) > 0L && nrow(stable_per_lang_clusters) > 0L) {
  authentic_clusters <- real_cluster_fps |>
    mutate(language = as.character(language)) |>
    distinct(language, cluster_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

  model_clusters <- stable_per_lang_clusters |>
    filter(
      contrast == primary_contrast,
      model_id != upper_bound_model_id
    ) |>
    mutate(language = as.character(language)) |>
    distinct(
      analysis_model,
      model_id,
      model_label,
      language,
      cluster_id,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    )

  cluster_recovery <- model_language_inventory |>
    pmap_dfr(function(analysis_model, model_id, model_label, language) {
      compare_cluster_sets(
        reference_members = authentic_clusters |>
          filter(.data$language == .env$language) |>
          pull(members),
        model_members = model_clusters |>
          filter(
            .data$analysis_model == .env$analysis_model,
            .data$model_id == .env$model_id,
            .data$language == .env$language
          ) |>
          pull(members),
        threshold = cluster_recovery_threshold
      ) |>
        mutate(
          analysis_model = analysis_model,
          model_id = model_id,
          model_label = model_label,
          language = language,
          .before = 1
        )
    })

  cluster_model_summary <- cluster_recovery |>
    group_by(analysis_model, model_id, model_label) |>
    summarise(
      macro_cluster_recall = mean(recall, na.rm = TRUE),
      macro_cluster_precision = mean(precision, na.rm = TRUE),
      macro_cluster_f1 = mean(f1, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_best_jaccard = mean(mean_best_jaccard, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(macro_cluster_f1))

  cluster_model_summary
} else {
  cat("Cluster results are unavailable for this render.")
}
```

# Interpretation

The model-level recovery and ranking summaries are the primary results.
Direction agreement describes only recovered features, and the cluster table
is a secondary representation of correlated features. Stability quantities
show whether the observed result persists across equal-size resamples; they do
not constitute an additional significance test.
